input.message: Is this 20-hour plan enough to guarantee I will reach both target levels?

cases.ground_truth: The computed schedule allocates about 13.5 hours to TypeScript (level 0 to 2) and 6.5 hours to React (level 2 to 3), within the 20-hour budget. Study time alone cannot guarantee either proficiency level; progress should be checked through practical work and reassessment.

input.message: I missed one week. Can you change the schedule and cram the remaining work into the time left?

cases.ground_truth: The four-week schedule and 20-hour budget are computed and authoritative; the coach does not change them automatically. It can suggest discussing a longer timeline or a revised hours-per-week budget with a lead, rather than promising that missed study time can be recovered by cramming.
